note: Jamaica: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 180 days (the Dominican Republic, since 4 February 2025), 6 months (the United States), 90 or 30 days; some only as tourists and some within a year (the footnotes' marks are lost in the copy, not modelled). Everyone else needs a visa; a stay on a Schengen, Canadian, UK or US visa for Honduras and some European nationals isn't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency's own table of entry visa requirements: it confirms the 6 months, 180, 90 and 30 days it states, and corrected Wikipedia's copy, read before, on the Maldives and the Cayman Islands (a visa), American Samoa (a visa, apart from the United States), and Andorra, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Taiwan and the British Virgin Islands, whose visa 'may be obtained at the port of entry' (a visa on arrival, no length given). It gives no length for the Commonwealth's members, whose 90 days stand on Wikipedia's copy; the 30 days for some European and other nationals holding a US, Canadian, UK or Schengen visa, and the vaccination proof it asks of some, aren't modelled.
